parameters.content:
## QF-MVP-50.2E — CLIENT WHATSAPP EXECUTOR (SELF-HOSTED STAGING CANDIDATE)

**KEEP INACTIVE / UNPUBLISHED.**

Default path is fail-closed because `QF_N8N_TRANSPORT_ENABLED` must equal `true`.

Secrets are runtime env references only; never paste secret values into this workflow.

Required later on self-hosted n8n: `QF_CORE_STAGING_BASE_URL`, `QF_N8N_WORKER_ID`, `QF_N8N_TO_CORE_HMAC_SECRET`, `QF_CORE_TO_N8N_HMAC_SECRET`, `QF_N8N_TRANSPORT_ENABLED`. No new variable is introduced by 50.2E.

**n8n owns no business authority here.** It routes only on the Core-derived `workflowFamily`, sends only five identity fields to `execute-client`, branches only on the Core-authored `orchestrationState`, and echoes `executorReference` verbatim. It chooses no recipient, template, variable, provider, account, consent, idempotency key, classification, safe code or retry time.

`communication_pending` means the communication lane owns a pending retry for that exact message row. This workflow stops: it never completes it, never re-executes it and never opens a new automation attempt.

No Meta/WhatsApp send is reachable from here: zero of the six client actions is provider-ready.
